{{Quote|Watch for aggressive local fauna. The animals in this vicinity have been classed A-1 for vicious behavior.|[[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]]|<ref name="GB" />}}
The '''Gungan Swamp''' was the name of all the swamps and marshes that covered most of the surface of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Description==
The Gungan Swamp was named after the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] who inhabited the area. The Gungan Swamp was a complex and rich primeval ecosystem made of swamplands, tidal bassins, inland seas, sloughs, rivers, grasslands, ponds, lakes, lone mountains, cliffs and craggs. The waterways and channels that composed the Gungan Swamp were constantly changing, making travel very difficult. A large number of vegetal and animal species completed this ecosystem. It included large animals such as [[Falumpaset/Legends|falumpasets]], [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaas]], [[Ikopi/Legends|ikopis]] and [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadus]].<ref name="TWoSWAFG" />

[[File:Gungan_Sacred_Place.png|thumb|left|250px|The [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]].]]
Several wetlands composed the Gungan Swamp, including the [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]],<ref name="ItWoSWEI" /> the [[Eastern swamps/Legends|Eastern swamps]],<ref name="BSV" /> the [[Lasay Swamp]] and the [[Paitnnu Wetlands]].<ref name="SWG" /> The Lianorm Swamp stretched over an area of thirty-four square miles and was located on the edge of [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] and the foothills of the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]]. The Lianorm Swamp was noteworthy for being the location of the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]] and [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].<ref name="ItWoSWEI" />

==History==
{{Quote|My troops are in position to begin searching the swamps for these rumored underwater villages. They will not stay hidden for long.|OOM-9|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
<div style="float: right">[[File:TF_landing_Naboo.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] forces landing in the [[Lianorm Swamp]].]]</div>
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] landed its forces in the Lianorm Swamp during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="ItWoSWEI" /> It was from here that [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] led [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to Otoh Gunga. After the [[Capture of Theed/Legends|Fall of Theed]], Trade Federation forces deployed in the Gungan Swamp to [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|raid]] Gungan villages. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] later went to the Gungan Sacred Place to meet [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] and finally form an alliance between the Gungans and the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TPM" />
